# Founding Pilot Agreement — TEMPLATE

> **This is a plain-language starting-point template, not legal advice.** Have
> it reviewed before relying on it for anything contentious. It is deliberately
> short — clarity between you and an early customer matters more than legal
> armour at this stage. Fill in the bracketed fields.

---

**Between:** GrowMatic SA ("GrowMatic"), represented by [Your full name]
**And:** [Customer company name] ("the Customer"), represented by [Their name]
**Date:** [Date]

## 1. What GrowMatic provides

GrowMatic will provide the Customer access to GrowMatic Recover, a tool that
imports the Customer's quote data, identifies quotes with no recorded outcome,
and helps the Customer's team follow them up. GrowMatic will help the Customer
import their initial data and get set up.

## 2. What this is (and isn't)

GrowMatic Recover highlights quotes that appear unresolved based on the
Customer's own data. **It does not guarantee that any flagged amount is
recoverable revenue.** Figures shown are a factual read of the Customer's data,
not a prediction or a promise of income.

## 3. Fees

- Once-off setup and onboarding: **R3,500** (payable on signature).
- Monthly subscription: **R1,800 per month**, starting [date], billed monthly
  in advance.

## 4. Term and cancellation

This agreement runs month to month. Either party may end it with **14 days'
written notice** (email or WhatsApp is fine). The setup fee is non-refundable
once onboarding has begun. No monthly fees are charged after the notice period.

## 5. The Customer's data

- The Customer's data remains the Customer's property.
- GrowMatic will use it only to provide this service, will not sell or share it
  with third parties, and will keep it secured.
- On request after cancellation, GrowMatic will delete the Customer's data
  within 30 days, and can provide an export of it beforehand.
- Both parties will handle personal information in line with POPIA. (See the
  separate Privacy Notice.)

## 6. Availability

GrowMatic will make reasonable efforts to keep the service available but does
not guarantee uninterrupted access during this pilot period. GrowMatic's total
liability under this agreement is limited to the fees paid in the preceding
month.

## 7. Feedback

As a founding customer, the Customer agrees to share honest feedback on what
works and what doesn't. This shapes the product and is the point of a pilot.
